messages:
Alex: Heads-up — after the kernel-selector v3 rollout we're seeing a 15-20% perf regression on 8-GPU TP+PP jobs. Nsight timeline shows idle gaps between compute and all-reduce launches.
build-bot: deploy: v3-kernel-selector rolled to production at 1767504000 (ci/cd) :rocket:
Priya: Can you paste the nsight timeline + nvprof summary? Where are we measuring regression (p50/p99/tokens-s)?
Alex: nvprof quick summary from repro run:
```
nvprof summary:
allreduce median: 0.85ms -> 1.50ms (post-rollout)
kernel_launch_latency median: 120us -> 220us
tokens/s: -18% overall, p99 latency +32%
```
Marco: My hunch: v3 selector now prefers fused-kernel-A for short seq lengths. fused-kernel-A has higher launch overhead for small microbatches, which kills comm/compute overlap.
Marco: try this temporary kernel policy tweak:
```
kernel_selector:
  prefer: ["fused-B", "vectorized"]
  avoid: ["fused-A"]
```
Xia: Also noticed KV-cache prefetch moved to a background thread in the same PR — that introduced a sync point at microbatch boundaries. NVTX shows KV_LOAD ranges aligning with the all-reduce start causing gaps.
Alex: Good catch. I'm going to add high-res custom timers around: all-reduce start/end, kernel launch, KV-load start/end. Also add NVTX ranges on every memcpy/launch. Sampling every 1000 steps should be enough.
Priya: Please open a perf ticket with repro steps + nsight capture. I'll run a full GPU trace on a rack tonight.
Alex: Filed PERF-1423 with minimal repro. Repro to run locally:
```
./perf/run_tp_pp.sh --seq 1024 --microbatch 2 --profile=nsight --steps=200
```
Marco: Quick local experiment: flipping back to old kernel policy reduces the regression to ~3% — strongly implicates selector. Should we revert v3 in prod canary?
Xia: If we revert, we should still patch the KV prefetch change (it reduces syncs when done right). Proposed hotfix: revert selector + change KV background prefetch -> inline prefetch with async memcpy + cudaEvent-based sync.
Priya: :thumbsup: Do a canary revert on dedicated pool A, watch tokens/s and tail latency. @engineering-oncall please monitor related alerts and tracing.
ops-bot: Canary revert scheduled to pool-dedicated-A at 1767508000. Monitoring dashboards: https://internal/monitoring/dashboards/perf-pool-dedicated-A
Alex: Uploaded nvprof flame and short nsight capture link: https://internal/nsight/1767504321/capture — will attach full export when ready.
Priya: Thanks — let's coordinate rollback window and postmortem next week.
